title: zeroTwist_constructible
statement: Let ell be prime and X any scheme. The actual signed Tate twist tateTwist X ell 0 is constructible as a module over condensedRingObj(padicAlgClRingObj ell) X. This zero-twist assertion needs no invertibility assumption on ell.

source.place: Zero twist and degree-zero realization; elementary shifted-single calculation needed for the Poincare Tate target.

proof.text: By definition the zero twist is the tensor unit, the regular coefficient module. Choose the one-stratum identity stratification and the identity pro-etale covering. Each of the two inverse images sends the tensor unit to the regular module through mapModUnitIso. The regular module is the cokernel of the zero morphism from the free module of rank zero to the free module of rank one, using biproductUniqueIso and cokernelZeroIsoTarget. Transport this presentation across the two unit isomorphisms.
